title: Verify: Retry and Reject 401 return to the token gate unit tests
summary: Add Retry 401 and Reject 401 AdminApp tests
description: Add two tests to the existing 'AdminApp execution action errors' describe in adminActions.test.tsx using stubActionFetch.
acceptance_criteria: Given Retry returns 401, then the gate shows 'Invalid token'
Given Reject returns 401, then the gate shows 'Invalid token'
technical_constraints: Fixtures: failedExecutionFixture and executionFixture already in the file, matching ExecutionInfo in game/frontend/src/api/client.ts and the backend admin executions handler

steps.symbol: it: retry endpoint returns 401 shows the token gate
steps.action: Add a test that calls stubActionFetch([failedExecutionFixture], () => json({ error: 'unauthorized' }, 401)), renders AdminApp, enters token 'secret', clicks the Retry button, then asserts findByRole('alert') has text 'Invalid token' and getByLabelText('Admin token') is present.
steps.command: npx vitest run tests/adminActions.test.tsx -t "retry endpoint returns 401"

steps.symbol: it: reject endpoint returns 401 shows the token gate
steps.action: Add a test with awaiting = { ...executionFixture, status: 'AWAITING_APPROVAL' }, stubActionFetch([awaiting], () => json({ error: 'unauthorized' }, 401)), click the Reject button, then assert the alert 'Invalid token' and the 'Admin token' field.
steps.command: npx vitest run tests/adminActions.test.tsx -t "reject endpoint returns 401"
